doc.title: SparkFun Qwiic OLED 1.3in (SSD1306) Schematic (breakout header J3) and Hardware Overview
doc.revision: Qwiic_OLED_1.3in rev v10 (schematic date 2023-06-09; controller SSD1306)
doc.pinNumbering: Pins 1-4 follow breakout header J3 (and Qwiic connectors J1/J2) on the rev v10 schematic: 1 GND, 2 VCC, 3 SDA, 4 SCL.
doc.notes: 4-pin I2C OLED breakout driven by Solomon Systech SSD1306 (default I2C address 0x3D on this board, 0x3C when ADDR jumper closed; 2.2 kOhm I2C pull-ups on board). VCC is 3.3 V power input (VDD on schematic, silkscreen 3V3).
